shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -25; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#|@spec|spec:'"' src/*.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -35; cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -100; cat jest.config.js"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; rg -n 'spec anchor|specs/.+#|@spec' .lore scripts src | head -50"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '32,42p'; node --input-type=module -e \"import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; import {segmentStatements} from '@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/spec/spec-segment.js'; console.log(JSON.stringify(segmentStatements(readFileSync('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md','utf8')),null,2))\" | tail -45"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"  it('reports the sum of every reported provider call across tool rounds'\", \"  // specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#11\\n  it('reports the sum of every reported provider call across tool rounds'\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts#L36','chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts#L39')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'test(orchestrator): define turn usage acceptance' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
